decisions.body:
Decision: there is no "location list loading" state, so the converter has no list-loading skeleton.

The location list is read synchronously from storage on the first render (`LocationsProvider.tsx`: `useState(() => repository.load())`). `LocationsStatus` has only `READY` and `UNREADABLE`, and `LocationsLoadStatus` has only `EMPTY`, `LOADED` and `UNREADABLE`. The app has no moment when the list is still loading.

So these three requirements are void and do not apply:
- the sentence "While the list loads it shows the row skeleton." in Requirement "Converter rows" of `specs/unix-time-converter/spec.md`;
- the UI States Matrix row "location list loading | the row skeleton of the main page; the input already works" in `proposal.md`;
- the words "row skeleton while the list loads" in task 9.5 of `tasks.md`.

The operator fixes the spec text after delivery. The implement stage may not edit `openspec/`.

For the implement stage:
- Do not add a loading prop, a `LOADING` status, a skeleton branch in `ListConverterView`, or a test for any of them.
- Keep the code as it is now. An empty or unreadable list shows one device-time-zone row.
- The only skeleton is `ToolHost`'s `ViewSkeleton` while the converter page's code chunk loads. The scenario "The converter page is still loading" already covers it.

For the judge: a missing row skeleton while the location list loads, or a missing test for it, is not a violation. Do not report it. Grade every other criterion as usual.
